decisions.target: small business owners with a Cobalt card reader

actions.action: Savings boost on new money only, 4 weeks
Zero-interest advance up to $500, up to 20,000 customers

decisions.message: Thank you for your patience in recent weeks. For the next 4 weeks, new money you add to Cobalt savings earns an extra 0.5 points, on balances up to $50,000. If you need it, you can get a zero-interest advance of up to $500, repaid from your next deposit. We have added 150 support staff for the coming weeks.
decisions.why:
Chosen by the optimizer for week 7 (small business owners with a Cobalt card reader).
Actions: Savings boost on new money only, 4 weeks, Zero-interest advance up to $500, up to 20,000 customers, Extra support staff for 4 weeks.
Cost $1,900,000 of the $4M budget.

actions.action: Free instant transfers to other banks
Zero-interest advance up to $500, up to 20,000 customers
Free replacement card on request and payment alerts

decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. Instant transfers to other banks are free for the next 4 weeks. If you need it, you can get a zero-interest advance of up to $500, repaid from your next deposit. You can order a free new card at any time, and we now send an alert for every card payment.
